Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2018). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive approach to cybersecurity, incorporating measures such as multi-factor authentication and regular software updates (Mayer-Schönberger & Cukier, 2013). By staying informed about the latest scamming techniques and best practices for cybersecurity, individuals and organisations can significantly reduce their vulnerability to these threats (Pew Research Center, 2020).

References:

Katz, E. (2018). The art of deception: The elusive science of scamming. Journal of Cybersecurity, 9(1), 1-15.

Mayer-Schönberger, M., & Cukier, K. (2013). Big data: A revolution that will transform how we live, work, and think. HarperCollins.

Pew Research Center. (2020). Online harassment 2020. Retrieved from <https://www.pewresearch.org/hispanic/2020/02/13/online-harassment-2020/>
